mines.mine_notes: Acquired Aug 2021 (was care & maintenance); first gold pour Jul 2022, revenue from Aug 2022. Open pits: Bibiani Main Pit plus Walsh, Strauss, Grasshopper, Russell satellite pits. Plant throughput expansion to 4.0 Mt/y targeted by end of 2026; underground development planned. Limiting factors FY2025: elevated stripping, lower feed grades/recovery. Updated NI 43-101 reports for Bibiani/Chirano due beginning of May 2026.

Acquired from Kinross (90% interest). Production since Oct 2005; open pits (Obra, Sariehu, Mamnao, Mamnao-Sariehu gap, Aboduabo) plus underground (Akwaaba, Akoti Far South, Tano, Suraw, Obra). Underground fleet upgrade underway (11 new units). Limiting factors FY2025: low grade feed, low recovery from intertank screen issues at CIL plant. Growth: plant improvement projects to raise rate to 4 Mt/y; accelerate underground development at Akwaaba, Tano, Akoti.

notes: FY2025 = 11-month period ended Dec 31, 2025 (fiscal year-end changed from Jan 31 to Dec 31). Consolidated: produced 146,571 oz gold equivalent (146,571 oz Au; sold 143,138 oz); revenue US$482.59M at avg realized price US$3,372/oz; consolidated AISC US$3,902/oz sold (up 45% y/y due to higher sustaining capital + lower grades); cost of sales incl. depletion US$470.4M; net loss US$345.44M; operating cash outflow US$31.9M; cash US$43.99M; working capital deficit US$229.33M. Aug 2025 Financing Package: US$507.195M gross (senior debt US$180M, mezzanine US$125M, two US$25M gold streams, C$237.3M bought deal + C$13.75M Appian placement); additional US$30M drawn Dec 31, 2025 under accordion. Mineral resources (2024 technical reports, Bibiani + Chirano, net of depletion): ~4.6 Moz measured + indicated (+34%) and ~2.2 Moz inferred (+200%); reserves not restated in FY2025 MD&A (updated NI 43-101s due May 2026). All amounts in USD. Also listed: GSE:ASG, OTC:ASGOF. CEO Dave Anthony.
